summary: Mining Trust Revenue Features Testing Complete. All new features verified: (1) Advisor section with Mining Advisory Desk, role, response time badge, WhatsApp and Call buttons working. (2) Audience segmentation grid with 3 cards (Investors, Partners, Hosting Clients) visible and properly styled. (3) Offer cards section with 3 cards (Investor Call, Partner Setup, Hosting Inquiry) each with CTA buttons. (4) CTA-to-lead prefill behavior working correctly - clicking each offer CTA scrolls to lead section and prefills message with relevant topic. All regression tests passed for quick contact, sticky bar, FAQ, lead form, live metrics, video section, and footer CTA. No layout or usability issues found.
